    "Finding specific files or information can be cumbersome"

  "overall_experience": "The VP Strategy likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward and effective tool for managing client projects and team collaboration, appreciating its simplicity over feature bloat. While it helped consolidate communication and tasks, they probably found its functionality somewhat limited for more complex strategic oversight or detailed reporting. The flat pricing was a clear benefit, but occasional frustrations with navigation or notification management may have occurred."
